datasets.dataset_name: ResPlan (A Large-Scale Vector-Graph Dataset of 17,000 Residential Floor Plans)
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (GitHub Data Release) / CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (Kaggle mirror discrepancy noted)
datasets.copyright_or_provenance_notes: Official GitHub release specifies CC BY 4.0 for derived vector geometry; Kaggle mirror displays CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Commercial training is gated by release-specific verification and must use the verified GitHub CC BY 4.0 data release.
datasets.allowed_use: Research, evaluation, and commercial development strictly via verified CC BY 4.0 release
datasets.attribution_requirement: Abouagour et al., ResPlan: A Large-Scale Vector-Graph Dataset of 17,000 Residential Floor Plans, 2025

datasets.paper_reference: Kalervo et al., CubiCasa5k: A Dataset for Floorplan Image Analysis, 2019
datasets.copyright_or_provenance_notes: Strictly non-commercial license per author terms and issue #60. Model weights trained on this dataset cannot be deployed in commercial products.
datasets.allowed_use: Evaluation, academic validation, and zero-shot algorithmic benchmarking only

datasets.copyright_or_provenance_notes: Unverified provenance web imagery. Contains 185 unique designs, 2 exact duplicate pairs, and 75.9% low-resolution thumbnails. Strictly designated as a noisy stress-test suite.
datasets.allowed_use: Internal robustness stress testing, OCR failure mode testing, and morphological edge-case evaluation

datasets.copyright_or_provenance_notes: 50 deliberately stratified floor plans (1-2BHK: 10, 3BHK: 15, 4+BHK: 10, L-shaped: 5, duplex: 5, unusual: 5) with 100% human-verified boundaries, doors, windows, room labels, and graphs.
datasets.allowed_use: Definitive regression benchmark for measuring IoU, precision, recall, and graph edit distance
